findings.claim: Class 8 orders rebounded sharply in 2026: ACT May 2026 preliminary orders up 103% y/y; FTR YTD order intake +112%; while Class 8 sales Jan-May 2026 were 73,419 units, down 16% y/y (Omdia).
ACT January 2026 outlook said manufacturers carried production restraint into early 2026 to work down excess inventory (destocking phase early 2026).
Cummins 10-Q: finished products inventory rose from $3,091M (2025-12-31) to $3,215M (2026-03-31) to $3,560M (2026-09-30); filings do not break out distributor vs company-held inventory.
Q2 2026 Cummins results tied partly to OEM inventory stocking to mitigate logistics risks in the Middle East; Distribution segment sales up 9% to $3.3B.
findings.source: Truck Parts & Service: Cummins raises 2026 outlook in Q2 earnings report

findings.claim: US PPI for special industry machinery rose Dec 2025 299.081 -> Jan 2026 301.619 -> Feb 2026 303.624 (price trend firming; not a spot/contract series for CMI end-markets).

cyclical_inventory_price_position.note: No direct Cummins channel/distributor inventory disclosure or engine-specific spot/contract price series found. Late-2026 pre-buy then 2027 digestion risk mentioned by one outlet only (unverified).
